correctness.rationale: The 12-vertex graph from source edges has 30 edges, degree five, distance shell sizes (1,5,5,1), and antipodal equality DN(I,D)=DN(I,3−D). Independent exhaustive bitmask enumeration gave exact face and mod-two Betti counts for all four key cases, including 1006 faces and β2=6,β3=21 for D={0,1,3},{0,2,3}. Independently reconstructed ALL FIFTEEN staged acyclic face-poset matchings and verified critical cells; the two mixed sets have exactly one critical 0-cell, six critical 2-cells and 21 critical 3-cells. Independently recomputed every signed integral gradient-path attaching coefficient; each 6×21 Morse boundary matrix is zero. Since π2(vee^6 S²)=H2=Z^6, all 3-cell attachments are null, proving the mixed wedge and integral torsion freeness. Acyclic matchings, not finite field Betti alone, prove all full homotopy types.

value.rationale: An exact, all-fifteen classification of a natural distance-neighborhood construction on the canonical icosahedral graph fills explicit omissions in the original dissertation. The mixed-dimensional 6+21 wedge is a nontrivial finite integral homotopy fact with complete reproducible Morse certificates; natural finite classification need not imply a general graph theorem.

limitations: Finite single icosahedral graph, all nonempty D; no equivariant or persistence claim.
Betti computations alone do not determine mixed homotopy type; the independent integral signed Morse zero-boundary plus Hurewicz argument is required.
